extracted.intended_audience: writers and translators interested in submitting or nominating work for the PEN America Literary Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Information page about the PEN America Literary Awards program, its purpose, eligible genres, award types, and submission windows; intended to guide writers/translators considering submission or nomination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: recognition of outstanding literary voices
rubrics_metrics.description: The PEN America Literary Awards honor 'many of the most outstanding voices in literature' and seek to 'celebrate the talent and voices of the poets and writers most often marginalized by business as usual.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program's intent is to recognize literary excellence and to advance and diversify the literary canon; awards are given to original and promising writers and translators. This statement indicates selection emphasis on literary quality and on amplifying marginalized voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards cover diverse genres, 'including fiction, poetry, science writing, essays, sports writing, biography, children’s literature, and drama.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants/nominees should check specific award pages for exact genre eligibility, but the program broadly encompasses both literary and nonfiction genres as listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of awards and funding
rubrics_metrics.description: PEN America confers 'over 20 distinct awards, fellowships, grants and prizes each year, awarding nearly $350,000 to writers and translators.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program includes multiple award categories (awards, fellowships, grants, prizes) with varying purposes and amounts. Prospective entrants should consult individual award descriptions to determine award type and monetary value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission window / deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions and nominations for the 2022 cycle were open June 1–August 1, 2021.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual award cycles have specific open/close dates; applicants must adhere to posted deadlines. The page links to 'Submission Guidelines' and individual award pages for current cycles and exact submission requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find detailed requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'SUBMISSION GUIDELINES' section and links to a full list of awards, archives of past winners, and individual award pages are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page functions as an index; detailed eligibility rules, entry formats, length limits, supporting materials, and judging criteria are likely on each award's dedicated page or in the full submission guidelines. Entrants should follow those specific pages for concrete entry requirements.
